ShiftCard.description: Displays daily shift info. Color-coded by shift type.

BottomNavigation.description: Sticky bottom tab bar for mobile.
BottomNavigation.styles: fixed bottom-0 w-full sm:max-w-md bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-zinc-200 flex justify-around items-center p-4 pb-8 z-50

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for flat elements. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Rely on structural borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-zinc-200 for bottom nav.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react with high-contrast stroke widths (2px or 2.5px).

Paramedic inside ambulance, good for header graphic or generic team graphic.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='user-select-button'`).
Build a mobile-first UI. Force a max-width constraint (e.g., `w-full sm:max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen`) so it behaves like a mobile app even on desktop browsers.
No login flow! The initial screen must be a 'Select User' view grouping the 16 people into 3 roles: Autisti (5), Capoturno (5), Soccorritori (6).
Color Code Shifts: Mattina=Yellow, Pomeriggio=Orange, Notte=Black.
Use Italian language for all UI elements (es: Turni, Calendario, Scambia Turno, Richiedi Ferie, Esporta).
Implement a sticky Bottom Navigation bar for core routes: Home (Turni), Calendario, Scambi (Swaps), Profilo/Admin.
Admin section must include features to generate shifts (fair rotation), manual edit, and holiday tracker (rotation for Ferie like Ferragosto).
Implement an export feature (PDF/CSV) for the monthly calendar.
Use standard Tailwind classes. For Shadcn components (if used), ensure they fit the mobile form factor (e.g., full width buttons, large touch targets).
